examples.title: Fiber Source Hunt
examples.problem: Look at a shirt label. It says '100% Cotton'. Where did the raw material come from?
examples.solution: The cotton plant (specifically the seed pods or bolls).
examples.explanation: Cotton is a natural plant fiber harvested from cotton fields.

examples.title: Silk Journey
examples.solution: Silkworms spin cocoons -> Cocoons are boiled -> Silk threads are unwound -> Threads are woven into cloth.
examples.explanation: Silk is a high-quality animal fiber known for its shine and strength.

examples.title: Winter Wear Choice
examples.problem: Why do we wear wool in winter?
examples.solution: Wool traps air between its fibers, and air is a poor conductor of heat.
examples.explanation: This helps keep our body heat from escaping into the cold surroundings.
